_comment: Budgets for scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs (kB). Initial = what index.html loads before the shell renders. Lazy chunks (editor, terminal, graph) and media are reported but deliberately not budgeted here. 185 -> 186 in 1.40: the settings store (two files, migration hooks, live settings.json reload) and the Mod+, shortcut; the registry and settings UI stay lazy. 186 -> 188 in 1.41: cluster names, colours and environment badges in the sidebar and context switcher at first paint (cluster metadata) and the window tint; the hub, guardrails, setup guide and provider marks stay lazy. 188 -> 191 in 1.42: the auth center core (credential state, recovery fan-out to watches/logs/port forwards, status refresh) and auth error classification, needed by every view at startup; the sign-in dialog, toasts, badges, notice, add-cluster dialog and vault prompts stay lazy.
